descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-14 In-Room Dictation & Note Generation · S20 「现成的 spec：生成记录的调用把总时间和供应商的时间分开记」 Existing spec: a note-generation call logs its total time and the vendor's time separately

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U15 Generate timing: each run logs how long the AI call itself took, separately from the total; any run over 30 s where the AI service was not the cause is reviewed with Vikram. …（UAT 3.5）
  • U16 Each run records which AI ran: the note model (Haiku, or Mistral with the fallback recorded) and the speech-to-text engine used for the dictation (GPT-Live; Deepgram only with the ambient option).（UAT 3.1；UAT 3.9；TFA-94422 AC 6）

测试设计方法：性能（performance） — 量时间，看是不是在要求的秒数里。

Given Tim's api spec calling ai/notes:generateNote

When Run the spec by title

Then The aiCallLog row for notes.generateNote has providerMs ≥ 0 and durationMs ≥ providerMs and ≤ the measured time; the audit row carries the same provider_ms

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：Playwright verdict (3.5: AI time logged apart from the total). The per-call times and models of the S11 to S19 runs are read from the same rows right after each call (aiCallLog keeps only the 8 newest rows per user) and listed for review; runs over 30 s are flagged, not failed

在哪跑：本地 lane A（现成 Playwright 测试）；测试方法 API · 接口（Convex 函数）；矩阵里排的车道 现成测试（Tim 的 Playwright）（automated）

S20 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-14.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：本地 — main e02167f，本地栈（local stack, not a deployed build）；run folder runs/2026-10-14-local，lane A。

测试方法：API · 接口（Convex 函数）；辅助：PERF · 性能计时 — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 both 跑；来源：matrix（lane A）。
